items.description: Laptop screen crack repair (full display assembly)
items.rationale: Sudden external action in a conveyance (2.6.2) is covered; display breakage per 2.6.3(a). Repair is below the ~EUR 1,500 replacement value, so the ordinary display-assembly price applies. Deductible unknown.
Housing deformation at a corner is covered under 2.6.3(b) as part of the same loss; priced as an ordinary lower shell swap. Combined with line 1 it stays under the replacement value.
Treatment of a pre-existing surface condition is not a repair cost under 7.1.11 and 7.1.8(a), so the line is excluded.
Examination costs are covered under 5.2.3, capped at EUR 250 incl. VAT; a typical shop diagnostic charge is expected to fall well below that cap.
